name: Chorizo Pasta
description: One-pan pasta with browned sausage, capsicum, and onion in a herbed tomato sauce.

steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium. Add the cooking oil and sausage links and cook for a few minutes on each side, or until well browned (they do not need to be cooked through at this point).

Remove the sausage to a clean cutting board and slice into medallions. Return the sausage to the skillet and continue to cook until cooked through and browned on the cut sides. Remove the sausage to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, slice the capsicum and onion into thin strips. Add them to the skillet after removing the sausage. Stir and cook over medium heat just until they begin to soften slightly.
Add the sausage back to the skillet along with the pasta sauce, basil, oregano, and chili powder. Stir to combine and heat through.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the pasta. Once boiling, add the pasta and cook until tender (about 7 minutes). Drain, then add it to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Top with crumbled feta and chopped parsley if desired, then serve.
